title: fix(xtask): quick runs one changed submodule; the heavy filter reads flat suites through their modules
body:
## What changed

**Part 1: the quick `<submod>::` filter** (`xtask/src/quick_subs.rs`, hooks in `xtask/src/quick.rs`)

- A change outside the test fns of one submodule file of a directory suite (`tests/<suite>/<sub>.rs`) runs `cargo test -p <pkg> --test <suite> -- <sub>::`.
- The whole suite runs when:
  - `main.rs` changes outside its test fns;
  - the submodule has a `pub`/`pub(..)` item, `macro_rules!`, `macro_export` or `macro_use`, now or at the merge base;
  - the submodule is cfg-gated (not precise);
  - the text at the merge base is not available;
  - more than one submodule of the suite changes;
  - another rule picks the suite whole.
- The exact fn picks inside the filtered submodule are dropped, because the filter runs them.
- `describe` and `by_fn` move to `xtask/src/quick_describe.rs`. `quick.rs` was at 400 lines; it is now 362.
- Not done: per-source Gate maps in `map_modules`. A src change still runs the whole suite (the safe side). The decision file records this.

**Part 2: flat suites in the heavy filter** (`xtask/src/plan.rs`, `xtask/src/suites.rs`, `xtask/src/braces.rs`)

- `may_run_ignored` reads every suite through its module files, flat suites too. A `mod common;` line alone no longer gives a heavy step.
- These keep the heavy step (the safe answer):
  - `ignore`, `include!`, `#[path`, `#[cfg_attr(.., path = ..)]` in any file;
  - an unreadable file, or a module walk error;
  - a declared module whose file is absent;
  - a `mod` token in code that the line scan did not read as a declaration (`mod a; mod b;` on one line, `#[cfg(test)] mod b;`). The new `braces::code` blanks strings and comments for this count. `braces::count` now uses it.

Decision file: `docs/decisions/3706-xtask-submodule-filter.md`.

## Readings

- `cargo xtask gate release --dry-run`, heavy steps: **273 before, 99 after**. 174 steps are dropped. No step is added.
- Check script, independent of the module walk: for each dropped step, `grep -rln ignore` over the entry file, plus `tests/<m>.rs` and all of `tests/<m>/` for each `mod <m>` of the entry. Result: **174 suites, 0 with a match.**
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main --dry-run`: 1 step (`xtask unit tests`).
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --dry-run`: 0 steps ("the diff reaches no heavy lane").

## Pinning tests (`xtask/src/directory_selection_tests.rs`)

Red on the old code (5):
- `a_private_submodule_change_runs_only_that_submodule`
- `a_flat_suite_is_read_through_its_module_files`
- `a_clean_flat_suite_with_a_clean_module_gets_no_heavy_step` (includes `mod` in a comment and a string)
- `a_nested_inline_module_file_is_read` (`mod a { mod b; }`)
- `a_mod_token_the_scan_cannot_read_keeps_the_heavy_step` (`mod a; mod b;` and `#[cfg(test)] mod b;`)

Guards (green before and after; a mutation that removes each guard makes its test fail):
- `a_cfg_attr_path_keeps_the_heavy_step` (mutation checked)
- `include_or_path_in_a_child_module_keeps_the_heavy_step`
- `an_unreadable_module_keeps_the_heavy_step`
- `main_shared_gated_or_two_submodules_run_the_whole_suite`
- `a_submodule_that_was_shared_at_the_base_runs_the_whole_suite`
- the `unsure` count is mutation checked through `a_mod_token_the_scan_cannot_read_keeps_the_heavy_step`.

Changed pin: `directory_tests::edges::quick_checks_old_and_new_hunk_sides_without_widening_in_test_edits`. Its first case edits a private submodule outside its fns. The expected plan changes from the whole `group` suite to `group -- cases::`.

## Quick gate (final head)

- `cargo test -j 6 -p xtask -- --test-threads=6`: 311 unit tests and all integration binaries pass.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

## Not exercised

- No real cut gate with the smaller heavy plan.
- No real `cargo test` run of a `<sub>::` filter step. The fixture tests check the plan text only.
- The files `xtask/src/exec.rs`, `main.rs` and `build_stop*.rs` are not changed (PR #3708).

Effort: medium (not escalated).

Changelog: none
Process change: yes

Fixes #3706
